scope: Offline matched continuation of the same 1536-parameter projection, through joint versus residual per-photo fitting. Same frozen U2NETP body, parent projection, 96 synthetic draws, one update per draw, optimizer settings and fractional labels. No real-development labels, crop updates, checkpoint selection, new source photos or production changes.
question: Does training specifically through the residual readout improve material identity and downstream templates compared with changing only the readout of a joint-trained projection?
controls: Reproduce all 96 saved joint-control training losses and gradient norms and every final weight exactly. Replay all 192 joint-control synthetic predictions under both readouts, and all 52 real fixed-crop predictions. Evaluate the two trained projections under both readouts; do not choose the readout or checkpoint per photo.
evaluation: Retain all 96 training diagnostics and all 32 repeatedly inspected development photos (26 fixed crops, six unresolved). Inspect the same 21 synthetic examples and every real-photo panel. Separately evaluate all 64 predeclared unassigned radial views, with privileged known corners, under residual readout for both final checkpoints. Run a fresh paired 10-second full fitter and editable export comparison of joint-trained-residual versus residual-trained-residual for all 32 real photos; report all failures. A lower self-mask error is not original-artwork accuracy.
limitations: Training uses 32 procedural geometries with plain/scene/printed views, not 96 independent designs.
The 32 real photos and 64 radial motifs have been inspected already; neither is a new held-out accuracy set.
Six earlier partial real training annotations are not added in this synthetic-only control; those labels do not cover material boundaries.
Keep the material classifier offline until real-photo fidelity, independent exports and unseen-source generalization justify a release.
